<!--
Apply exactly one priority label (P0-P3) when filing. Definitions and the weekly/monthly
workflow are in .github/TRIAGE.md.
-->

## Problem

<!-- What is wrong, where (file paths, routes, issue numbers), and who is affected. -->

## Proposed change

<!-- The smallest change that fixes it. Name alternatives you rejected and why. -->

## Acceptance

<!-- Observable conditions that make this done: tests that pass, behavior a reviewer can check. -->

## Suggested priority

<!-- P0, P1, P2 or P3, with a one-line reason. Default to P2 when unsure; pick the higher level when unsure on security or
eligibility correctness. -->

## Verification status

<!-- One of: reproduced / read from code only / unverified. Say how. Add the
`needs-verification` label if the claim or priority depends on behavior not yet observed. -->

## Blocked on

<!-- Optional. If the work cannot proceed without a human decision or another issue, write
"Blocked on: ..." and add the `blocked` label. Delete this section otherwise. -->
